description: Start a generation. SPENDS CREDITS from the wallet (held now, settled to the actual cost when the job ends; refunded if it fails). Returns a taskId immediately - follow it with get_task (waitSeconds) until completed. Use only the user's own prompt text. For image-to-video etc. upload the source first (upload_source_media). Requires an API key with the "generate" scope.

duration.description: Seconds, within the model's durationRange (respect its step).

generateAudio.description: For models with an audio toggle.

maxCredits.description: Spending ceiling. If the cost would exceed it the server refuses and charges nothing. Always set this when no human is watching.

mode.description: From the model's modes, if it has any.

negativePrompt.description: What to avoid (only models with hasNegativePrompt).

prompt.description: What to create, in the user's words.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio from the model's aspectRatios, e.g. "16:9".

sourceImageUrl.description: URL returned by upload_source_media. Only uploads made through TurboMax are accepted.

stylePreset.description: From the model's stylePresets. Omit for none (the prompt is used verbatim).

task.description: Task, e.g. "text-to-video", "image-to-video". Must be one the model supports.

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the result before returning (0-55). Default 0: return the taskId at once.

name: generate_media
title: Generate image / video / audio
